text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with emphysema. The combination of a long smoking history, chronic productive cough, exertional dyspnea, and spirometry showing a reduced FEV1/FVC ratio of 0.60 confirms an obstructive lung disease. The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms are classic signs of emphysema, a major component of COPD.
